skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single target with 4 consecutive strikes.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks all enemies with 5 consecutive strikes, dealing 300% ATK DMG. When attacking more than 3 enemies, each additional enemy increases the skill’s DMG by an additional 100% ATK. During the first 5 rounds, has a 100% chance to inflict [Specialized Stun] on the main target and enemies in the same row for 1 round. [Specialized Stun]: Prevents the affected unit from acting and permanently reduces its ATK by 30%. At most 4 characters can be affected by [Stun] or [Specialized Stun] at the same time.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks all enemies with 5 consecutive strikes, dealing 450% ATK DMG. When attacking more than 3 enemies, each additional enemy increases the skill’s DMG by an additional 150% ATK. During the first 5 rounds, has a 100% chance to inflict [Specialized Stun] on the main target and surrounding enemies for 1 round. [Specialized Stun]: Prevents the affected unit from acting and permanently reduces its ATK by 30%. At most 4 characters can be affected by [Stun] or [Specialized Stun] at the same time.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, grants self and surrounding allies immunity to [Corrode] and [Specialized Corrode] for 5 rounds.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, permanently grants self and surrounding allies immunity to [Corrode] and [Specialized Corrode].

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, permanently grants all allies immunity to [Corrode] and [Specialized Corrode].

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains a 45% chance of [Evade]. Removes [Combo Follow-Up] from the entire enemy team for the whole battle. [Evade]: Reduces Direct DMG, Extra DMG, Charge DMG, and Berserk DMG received to 1 DMG.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains a 60% chance of [Evade]. Removes [Combo Follow-Up] from the entire enemy team for the whole battle. After any character acts, for each enemy affected by [Specialized Stun], increases all allies’ [Specialized Protection] by an amount equal to 100% of Metal Knight’s ATK. Can trigger up to 3 times per round. [Evade]: Reduces Direct DMG, Extra DMG, Charge DMG, and Berserk DMG received to 1 DMG.

effects.desc: PvP shields reduce or negate damage to allies.
PvP tier of Stun — harder to resist or resolve.
The stun-type control effect prevents the target from taking action during the duration.
Mark a unit, unlocking a raid condition or bonus effect associated with the mark.
One turn in a match; Many effects are limited to the current number of turns (e.g. only effective when Round < 6).
The dodge status reduces Direct, Bonus, Charged, and Fury damage taken to just 1 point for the duration.
A counter mark whose class number gradually increases the user's direct counter damage to marked enemies.
The enhanced Corrosion over Time damage variant has the ability to retarget itself, to which some units may be immune.
Continuous corrosive damage over time gradually erodes Health, which can be blocked by zone immunity.
